user_story: As a user, I want to receive an error when my password is shorter than 8 characters so that I use a secure password.

positive.title: User provides a valid password of exactly 8 characters
steps: Navigate to the password input field
Enter a password with exactly 8 characters, e.g., 'password'
positive.expected_result: User successfully submits the form without any error

positive.title: User provides a valid password greater than 8 characters
steps: Navigate to the password input field
Enter a password with 12 characters, e.g., 'securepassword123'
positive.expected_result: User successfully submits the form without any error

negative.title: User provides a password shorter than 8 characters
steps: Navigate to the password input field
Enter a password with 7 characters, e.g., 'short'
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long'

negative.title: User provides an empty password
steps: Navigate to the password input field
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long'

edge.title: User provides a password with special characters and is exactly 8 characters long
steps: Navigate to the password input field
Enter a password with exactly 8 characters, including special characters, e.g., '!@#$%^&*'
edge.expected_result: User successfully submits the form without any error

edge.title: User provides a password with spaces and is exactly 8 characters long
steps: Navigate to the password input field
Enter a password with exactly 8 characters including spaces, e.g., 'pass word'
edge.expected_result: User successfully submits the form without any error
